definition: Closed reconciled same-stall, same-weekday sessions; normal + clearance sales. Zero closing leftovers conservatively censor demand. No weather effect is inferred.

interval.caveat: Split residual interval; time-series exchangeability is not assured. Empirical test coverage is descriptive, not a guarantee.

benchmark.release_gate: Trend must improve the preselected baseline on holdout; otherwise display baseline. Holdout is used for this release decision, not training.

recommendation: Review the forecast and unsold estimate before choosing preparation; it does not change a batch or safety deadline.
